method.period: Same 235 archived qualified XAUUSD setups, August 3–November 18, 2026
method.TP: Targets are multiples of ORIGINAL reference-to-SL distance, measured from original reference. Original stop never moves. Actual per-entry RR differs with pullback entry. Common target multiples 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2/2.5/3/4. Split targets 1:1.5, 1:2, 1:3, 1.5:2 and 1.5:3 for first/second legs.
method.entries: Six entry profiles from earlier studies; all reference anchored except old-method comparator. Body percentages mean final confirmation candle body. Risk shares and deadlines are explicit per profile. No increase in fixed $4 setup risk.
method.cancellation: original-target cancels any pending entries when ORIGINAL 1R TP is touched, but already-filled positions retain their larger experimental TP. new-target lets each pending leg remain eligible until its own experimental TP, SL or entry deadline. New-target can add later fills after the original trade would already have ended.
method.execution: Offline per-leg state machine enumerates all possible OHLC event orders. Independent TP/SL states support split targets. Buy/sell mirror fixtures and original/corrected baseline parity pass. No breakeven, partial close or stop changes. Gaps and ordering conflicts remain uncertain; open positions are not counted as losses or wins.
method.selection: Fit only earlier outcomes truncated at October 1 and November 1. Require >=85% both-entry fills, >=60% old resolved training count and positive conservative training R. Profit selection requires >=45% profitable resolved setups; balanced selection >=55%. Maximize conservative training R, then known-outcome R. Apply each choice to next month.
method.counting: For common TP, TP/SL setup counts behave as previous studies. Split targets can create mixed TP/SL setups. Profitable-setup win rate is positive net R / all fully resolved filled setups; a mixed setup may be profitable or losing. Entry TP/SL counts are separately reported. Whole uncertain/open setups excluded from main P&L; scenario lower/upper bounds retain their risk.
method.cash: Fixed $4 total setup risk, ideal fractional lots, no compounding. No spread, fees, slippage, margin, min-lot sizing, daily-loss or maximum-open-position limits, and no overlap half-risk adjustment. Higher targets hold trades longer, so these omissions can matter more. Existing $200 Exness minimum-lot constraint remains; results are not executable account returns.
method.history: Archived qualified setups and historical dates were reused from earlier studies, not regenerated under a new strategy or independently unseen. Multiple searches increase overfitting. Missing bars remain uncertain. Monthly fold boundaries close the scoring window, not actual positions; no cross-fold position carry.
method.scope: Experimental TP changes in offline research only. Trading source, live exits, account settings and open orders untouched.

dayResampling.method: Paired resampling by confirmation UTC calendar day, Python random seed 20261120, 10,000 replicates. Uses ideal known-outcome P&L; does not resolve OHLC uncertainty or correct for repeated strategy selection. Not independent significance evidence.
